pipelines.description: Comma separated globs naming the Azure Pipelines definitions to read.

job-timeout-set.name: Pipeline jobs declare a timeout
job-timeout-set.description: Every job declares a timeout, and none of them asks for the maximum, so a hung job is stopped instead of holding an agent.
job-timeout-set.remediation:
Set a timeout on each job:

```yaml
jobs:
  - job: build
    timeoutInMinutes: 15
    steps:
      - script: ./gradlew check
```

A job that doesn't declare one gets 60 minutes on a Microsoft-hosted agent and runs forever on a self-hosted one. `timeoutInMinutes: 0` asks for the maximum, which on a self-hosted agent means no limit at all, so the guardrail treats it the same as declaring nothing.

maxMinutes.description: Longest timeout accepted. A job that declares more than this is treated as declaring none.
